I don't think this level can be won under the rules as written, so I won't submit a winning sequence.

The only door I can reach is (10,2), which is in the top-right room. That room's only entrance is the gate at (10,4). Gate (10,4) opens only when all three plates, (2,6), (6,6) and (10,6), are held at once, and a hero can enter the gate only from (10,5) while it is open. So the entering hero must be a fourth body: the three plates need three holders, and the entrant stands on none of them. Plates are not adjacent to either gate, so no single move can bridge this gap.

The only extra body is the crystal at (2,2), but it is sealed in the top-left room behind gate (2,4), which has the same problem. The wizard's swap, the thief's pull and the warrior's push can't get around this, since each needs a hero already in the top-right room or the gate. With three heroes, the level cannot be completed.

If I've misread a rule, such as how plates are pressed or how gates open, tell me which one and I'll redo the analysis.

<moves></moves>

Checker: NOT WON after 0 moves
You have 2 answers left.

My earlier claim that the level is unsolvable was wrong. I missed that the wizard can stand on a plate and swap with the crystal through an open gate, which gives a fourth presser.

The plan:
1. The thief goes to plate (10,6), and the warrior goes to (6,1) to clear the path.
2. The wizard walks to plate (2,6), and the warrior goes to plate (6,6). All three plates are now pressed and both gates open.
3. The wizard swaps with the crystal, so the crystal takes plate (2,6) and the wizard is in the top-left room.
4. The warrior walks around to (1,6) and pushes the crystal east onto plate (6,6). The warrior then returns to plate (2,6).
5. The wizard swaps back down with the warrior, so the wizard presses (2,6). The warrior walks through the open gate, around to (10,5), and enters the top-right room through gate (10,4) to reach door (10,2).
6. The thief and wizard then walk to doors (5,1) and (7,1), the thief pulling the crystal along its path and the wizard swapping with it once.

I checked each step against the beam, pull and push rules, but I haven't run it through the checker.
